method: Manual labelling by eye from front and side projections of the decoded GLB and confirmed with real taps in the app (labelConfidence: medium). This model is one node with 25 primitives, so it is resolved by material name. The scene names the primitives Extravehicular_Mobility_Unit_<index+1> and hides the ones whose name ends in _4, _5, _6, _7, _9 or _13, plus those with partial transmission.
